text: {"lessons":["I enjoy locking in gains, but selling winners too quickly can leave meaningful upside behind; I should base exits on the outlook, not just a gain versus my cost.","I tend to judge each stock separately and feel the pain of a loss; average cost is not a reason to hold—each position should earn its place in the portfolio from here.","My repeated sales have raised cash, so I should weigh each trade against the portfolio’s overall risk, diversification, and long-term goals rather than acting on habit."]}
